title: 臨床心理学概論
subtitle: Introduction to Clinical Psychology
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1)the outline of clinical psychology.
(2)about psychological assessment and intervention.
(3)stress coping skills and their application.
advice:
This is a basic clinical psychology course. We will cover the following topics:

(1)Psychological assessment
(2)Psychological intervention
(3)Psychological practice
(4)Research methods and ethics in clinical psychology
requiredKnowledge: Basic and fundamental knowledge of psychology is required.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand the outline of clinical psychology.
Ability to understand and discuss various stress coping methods.
Ability to discuss ethical principles of psychology.
